maria: Hotfix PR #9123 is ready to merge, CI green. We need two approvers before cutoff at 2026-03-18 23:00 PT. Ping codeowners @sam @jordan. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9123
sam: looking now, quick skim shows kv-cache patch and an env var reorder. i can give one LGTM if no functional regressions. running local smoke.
ci-bot: CI pipeline passed — unit, integration, smoke (all green) — build 6123
jordan: on lunch until 22:30 PT, can review after — if you need 2nd before cutoff, @dana can double-check?
dana: i can take second eye. will run the smoke tests asap. rerun the kv warmup test.
dana: smoke logs look clean. minor comment in PR about log level. +1 from me, will leave minor comment for follow-up.
sam: +1 from me. leaving LGTM on GH. tag @maria
maria: thanks both. will merge at cutover if nothing blocks. reminder: if one approver can't make it by t-minus 20 we'll abort and schedule rollback window. setting a calendar 23:00 PT cutover reminder.
oncall-bot: scheduled merge window at 2026-03-18T23:00:00-07:00. If autobackout triggered, rollback job will be queued.
jordan: back and gave a quick look — happy to sign off too, but since already 2x we don't need to rush. I approve for stability. :thumbsup:
maria: merging now. Thanks team :rocket:
